This breaks the TIMESTAMP cast, and a cast-only fix would also double-count batch 12 (5320 rows vs 4975 distinct txn_ids).", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.82, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH dedup AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]+') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS parsed_ts FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, parsed_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(parsed_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
